question.prompt: What should happen next with the density-change promise that no scenario can yet exercise?

options.label: Need source
options.detail: Keep density-change coverage deferred until a source defines the visible change that proves Compact or Spacious updated the dashboard.

options.label: Scope down
options.detail: Treat this use-case as covering density option availability and default only, not visible density-change behavior.

options.label: Author assumption
options.detail: Assume density changes spacing in place and add coverage on that assumption in a rework pass.

content.risk_rationale: Density change is named in the use-case and acceptance checklist, but the corpus still does not define the observable success condition, so no current scenario can exercise ac-141 without inventing behavior.

question.prompt: What should be asserted when Benchmark is re-enabled, given that the corpus only states the line returns?

options.label: Line only
options.detail: Assert only that the benchmark line returns, and leave legend restoration unresolved until a source states it.

options.label: Need source
options.detail: Add or cite source text that states whether the related legend element also returns when Benchmark is re-enabled.

options.label: Assume both
options.detail: Assume both the benchmark line and related legend return on re-enable.

content.risk_rationale: The disable behavior explicitly removes both the benchmark line and related legend, but the re-enable source text states only that the benchmark line returns; asserting legend restoration would go beyond the evidence.

content.text: Re-enabling Benchmark makes the benchmark line visible on the performance chart again.

expected_answer.operand: benchmark line on the performance chart

content.text: The keyboard-focused Customize control shows a visible focus indicator.

expected_answer.operand: visible focus indicator on the currently keyboard-focused Customize control

content.text: Pressing Space on the focused Allocation section toggle changes it from checked to unchecked.
Customize controls do not require hover to be focused or activated.

expected_answer.operand: a Customize control that only becomes focusable or operable on hover
